parts.text:
Beyond Snezhnograd's city walls, you suddenly hear the strange sound of someone singing...?

#### Follow the singing voice...

**???:** ♪~

#### Follow the singing voice...

- **Traveler:** (The voice seems to be coming from this hole... Hmm...)

**???:** ♪~!!!

- **Traveler:** (My ears... Ugh... They're ringing non-stop. Why does this voice sound so familiar...?)

- **Traveler:** (Should I jump down? Who knows what sort of trouble could be waiting... Right, let me test the waters first...)

- **Traveler:** Hello? Come out of there!

- **Traveler:** (No response...? This sudden silence is even more unsettling!)

- **Traveler:** (...But what exactly is down there? Well... there might be trouble, but there could also be treasure.)

- **Traveler:** (...Might as well take a look. If I encounter any danger, I'll make a quick exit.)

As you carefully climb down the ice wall, you lose your grip on the last stretch, falling straight into a puddle and getting completely soaked...

- **Traveler:** (Ugh... Just my luck... But looks like there's still a path ahead. Where am I...?)

**???:** ♪~

- **Traveler:** (This is the same singing as before. I should follow the voice...)

#### Follow the singing voice...

#### Explore the cave

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, did you forget which pillars were broken? I'll sing again. Watch closely this time, okay?

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, did you forget which pillars were broken? I'll sing again. Watch closely this time, okay?

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~

- **Traveler:** (A huge... shell? Strange. Did that song just now come from inside? Could it be a fae?)

- **Traveler:** (Hold on, speaking of singing fae... Could it be Vodyanitsa...?)

- **Traveler:** Hello? Anyone here?

- **Traveler:** (Still no response... Well, if there are mushroom gods in this world, there might as well be seashell fae. I should check it out.)

**Vodyanitsa:** Hi there, Traveler!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Waah!

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** V—Vodyanitsa!?

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Don't sound so surprised! Who else were you expecting? A lost little Snegurochka. A Vila who took a wrong turn? A Domovoy stranded in the middle of nowhere?

- **Traveler:** Sorry, why would they have to be lost...?

**Vodyanitsa:** Hehehe... Because my private practice room is so well-hidden, obviously! No one stumbles upon this place on purpose...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** True... and even if someone got lost...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Most wouldn't dare to jump down that cavern...

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, that! Yeah, I originally planned to channel some water over there and completely seal it off.

**Vodyanitsa:** But I asked a bunch of engineers, and they all said blowing up the cave's rock wall could cause landslides, avalanches, surface cracks, all kinds of bad things... Anyway, it'd be a huge pain.

**Vodyanitsa:** Plus, if the cave's original structure was destroyed, its acoustics would be ruined too, and then I wouldn't even be able to use it for practice.

**Vodyanitsa:** So, I gave up. And, anyway, it's just like you said — not many people would dare to jump down from up there.

- **Traveler:** So, this is really where you practice singing?

**Vodyanitsa:** I'm not answering that question, because you haven't answered mine. Who else were you expecting to see here?

**Vodyanitsa:** One person asks, the other person answers. Then comes the next question. That's how polite conversation should go.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Alright. I thought it might be a shell fae.

**Vodyanitsa:** ...A shell fae? You mean the "oyster sprites" that protect children who fall in the water? The ones from the fairytales? Fae like that don't exist in Snezhnaya.

**Vodyanitsa:** The only fae associated with pearls are us Water Imps. After all, legend has it that if we cry out of true sorrow, our tears will turn into pearls.

**Vodyanitsa:** Want me to cry for you right now? I could do it. I mean, we know each other so well, and you didn't even recognize my singing voice. That could get me going...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** N—No need! I wouldn't want to bring down the mood.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** ...That said, do Water Imp tears really turn into pearls?

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Of course not. Otherwise, there'd be nothing but pearls at the bottom of the water, now wouldn't there? I bet pearl necklaces wouldn't be nearly as expensive either...

**Vodyanitsa:** Plus, those pearls wouldn't be the quality kind. They'd be misshapen and have all sorts of impurities.

**Vodyanitsa:** If only there really were oyster sprites, though! I bet, if you paid one, you could get all sorts of beautiful pearl jewelry!

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, right! Take this pill to warm yourself up. You fell into a puddle on your way down, right?

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** ...Thanks.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Wait, how did you—

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** I heard your footsteps through the ice the minute you got to the entrance of the cave.

**Vodyanitsa:** You traversed the ice wall only to fall into the water at the last moment! I heard you sputtering from here, haha.

**Vodyanitsa:** Now, I was considering letting you have a few sips of strong liquor to warm you back up, but on second thought, spirits that have been frozen lead to intoxication too quickly.

**Vodyanitsa:** So I thought this pill would be better. It's something hunters use to warm themselves up out in the frigid wilderness.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** I was expecting you, of course.

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, I see... In that case, why did you hesitate at the entrance for so long?

- **Traveler:** Huh? How did you know that?

**Vodyanitsa:** I heard your footsteps through the ice the minute you got to the entrance of the cave.

**Vodyanitsa:** You traversed the ice wall only to fall into the water at the last moment! I heard you sputtering from here, haha.

**Vodyanitsa:** Now, I was considering letting you have a few sips of strong liquor to warm you back up, but on second thought, spirits that have been frozen lead to intoxication too quickly.

**Vodyanitsa:** So I thought this pill would be better. It's something hunters use to warm themselves up out in the frigid wilderness.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Thanks...

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Wait, then back in the shell just now... You...

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Yep! I wasn't about to watch you freeze to death after a fall like that. Go on. Down it goes.

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Good. Now we can get back to your question. You wanted to know why I practice in a place like this, right?

**Vodyanitsa:** Well, the answer's simple. Practicing in the city would disturb people.

- **Traveler:** Oh, of course...

**Vodyanitsa:** I used to practice in the theater, doing vocal warm-ups, singing a cappella. You know, stuff like that.

**Vodyanitsa:** Letting some fresh air in always puts me in a better mood, so I would usually practice with the window open.

**Vodyanitsa:** And, well, do I even need to say how captivating my singing voice is? Every time I practiced, a huge crowd of listeners would gather down below.

**Vodyanitsa:** And they wouldn't leave until I was done. Hehe, honestly, the people were packed as tight as sardines down there... But, it's not like I could do anything to help it.

**Vodyanitsa:** That said, there's another reason I don't really practice in the theater anymore.

**Vodyanitsa:** I don't exactly recall when, but one day, this young girl showed up in the crowd of people who had come to listen to me. She turned out to be quite smart.

**Vodyanitsa:** She studied my habits to the point where, at all times, she knew when and where I was going to practice. And sure enough, she'd always be there.

**Vodyanitsa:** People would even pay her to show them where I'd be so they could be sure to grab a spot.

**Vodyanitsa:** She made quite the sum that way. Now and then, she'd even send me a basket of flowers with a thick handwritten letter tucked inside.

**Vodyanitsa:** The letters weren't anything special — mostly the same flattery I've heard ten thousand times. They read a tad awkwardly, too... but at least they were sincere.

**Vodyanitsa:** So, I'd often send her a ticket to my latest show in return. I thought it'd make her happy.

**Vodyanitsa:** I like people who chase after what they love with all their might, but still have some smarts to show for it. I think people like that are fun and cute. I would've loved for our fun to continue.

- **Traveler:** So, what happened?

**Vodyanitsa:** She changed. She no longer came to my practice sessions because she liked to hear me sing.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hmm, she just wanted to make Mora. Lots and lots of it — enough that she could put all the relentless celebrity chasing behind her.

**Vodyanitsa:** That much I wouldn't have minded, but... then I discovered at some point, she started selling every single ticket I sent her for several times the price.

**Vodyanitsa:** I suppose she didn't like my music anymore. The innocent version of her who was just there for the love of my voice was no more.

**Vodyanitsa:** In human terms, she grew up. I no longer found her cute, fun, or interesting, and I certainly didn't want to play with her anymore, so I moved to a different practice location.

**Vodyanitsa:** I won't meet anyone interesting here, of course. But at least I can practice my singing in peace.

**Vodyanitsa:** Although... You braved the journey here, now didn't you! Freezing puddle and all, haha!

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** I feel much warmer now.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Just now, during practice, your voice sounded a bit...

##### Response branch 3

- **Traveler:** The little animals were all...

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** Ugh, don't even go there. It's been giving me such a headache. If the acoustics in this "echo chamber" were still in good shape, my voice wouldn't have come out nearly so...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Striking.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Piercing.

##### Response branch 3

- **Traveler:** Memorable.

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** That's exactly what I meant. Thank you, Traveler.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** This place looks like it's in good shape, though.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Where's the problem?

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** The problem isn't the main cave structure, but the Echo Pillars made of Prime Ice.

**Vodyanitsa:** Perhaps I was practicing too hard, or my pitch was too high, but while I was practicing a few days ago, some of the pillars suddenly cracked.

**Vodyanitsa:** Honestly, all I need are a few simple Prime Ice pillars to replace the damaged ones, and this chamber will be pretty much back in working order.

**Vodyanitsa:** But, alas, I'm terrible at making things like that...

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** What's that smile for?

##### Response branch 1

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Hold on, were you planning this from the start?

**Vodyanitsa:** No! It's like I said, all I heard were footsteps at the entrance. It's not like I lured you here or something...

- **Traveler:** Uh huh...

**Vodyanitsa:** I swear! Anyway, since I have you here, there's no time to waste! Let me tell you which pillars to swap.

**Vodyanitsa:** Hmm... Actually, just telling won't do. Ahem. I have a better method.

- **Traveler:** And what would that be?

**Vodyanitsa:** Shh.

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~

**Vodyanitsa:** There we go! See those brightly illuminated Prime Ice Pillars? Those are the broken ones.

##### Response branch 1

- **Traveler:** Wow, Prime Ice is something else.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** Wow, your voice is something else.

##### Shared continuation

**Vodyanitsa:** That goes without saying. Otherwise, I wouldn't be nearly so invested in all this, haha.

**Vodyanitsa:** Anyway, I'm counting on you, Traveler. If you forget which Prime Ice Pillars are broken, just come back to me. I'll show you again.

##### Response branch 2

- **Traveler:** You're hinting at something, aren't you?

**Vodyanitsa:** Hinting? Goodness no. I'm shamelessly asking for your help, of course.

##### Response branch 1

##### Shared continuation

- **Traveler:** Well, you did give me that pill...

#### Repair the echoing pillar(s)

#### Talk to Vodyanitsa

**Vodyanitsa:** Oh, I knew I could count on you! It turned out beautiful! The positioning of these Prime Ice Pillars is perfect!

**Vodyanitsa:** Now then. Let me test them out.

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~

- **Traveler:** Huh, they give off a soft glow now...

**Vodyanitsa:** That's right! Ah, looks like I can practice in peace for now. Hmm... Since you helped me fix these Prime Ice Pillars, allow me to sing you a little practice piece!

- **Traveler:** Ear protection compulsory or optional?

**Vodyanitsa:** Haha, unnecessary. My voice is all warmed up, so I'll do some a cappella now.

**Vodyanitsa:** I'm practicing here today, and in a few days, I'll head over to Dawn Station to do the same. I wonder if Odette and Alyosha will be there...

**Vodyanitsa:** Anyway, sit back and relax... Oh, but don't close your eyes, or you might zone out and fall face-first into the water!

**Vodyanitsa:** ♪~
